hypothesis: An explicitly bound long-horizon native-policy return, equally sampled per forced action, may yield repeatable partial supervision; no assumption that every action can be ordered or that neural guidance will improve.

primary_candidate_target.name: Q128_NATIVE_B64_H8_COMPOSITE_POLICY_RETURN_CANDIDATE_V1
primary_candidate_target.definition: Q_128^pi(s,a)=E[sum_{k=0}^{min(128,tau)-1}0.99^k r_k | s, forced first a, then pi]
primary_candidate_target.value_semantics: finite-window fixed-policy composite return; not optimal Q, not internal UCT child Q
primary_candidate_target.long_return_label_eligibility: All planned repetitions for both compared actions valid and truly terminated; any artificial cutoff makes that action long-return-label UNKNOWN. Its finite-window observations remain in outputs.
primary_candidate_target.complete_sample_qualification: Complete sampled returns do not prove that the policy terminates almost surely or that the infinite-horizon expectation is known.
primary_candidate_target.reward_policy: Use each episode exact frozen reward/transition context; do not copy C06 numbers into C04 or C11. Context must be bound before scientific START.
primary_candidate_target.change_from_old_target: New target-generator branch explicitly replaces random short-tree target with forced-first-action native-policy execution for candidate labels ONLY; old datasets/checkpoints are untouched.
primary_candidate_target.network_output: 16 unconstrained ranking scores for canonical actions, not calibrated Q/leaf values/safety probabilities
primary_candidate_target.auxiliary_cost: C64=min(T_ok,64); T_ok=+infinity for hard failure or no normal completion. Missing evidence=null/HOLD; no discount.
primary_candidate_target.auxiliary_not_loss: C64, hard-event frequency, sampled clearance and command smoothness kept separately; no weighted mixture, no substituted reward.

inherited_execution.policy_selector: native visits first, then q, then smaller canonical action
inherited_execution.first_step: One forced deterministic transition; no policy RNG consumption and no MCTS count for this step.
inherited_execution.subsequent_steps: Fresh native search tree each decision; same outer stream retained, never reseed each decision.
inherited_execution.true_terminal: frozen hard_safety_violation OR all_goals_reached; hard has priority if both on same step
inherited_execution.artificial_cap: 128 transitions includes first step, H8 remains unchanged; unknown tail not fabricated as zero task value
inherited_execution.allowed_actions: root 16 enumerated; after a car reaches goal its native legal set shrinks to KEEP; no pruning

selection.pool_provenance: 36 historical corrected pilot raw roots inside bound E31 runtime snapshot
selection.algorithm: For each episode in fixed order, choose pair maximizing standardized squared Euclidean distance over seven stored motion/geometry features, excluding any float32-12D feature key already selected. Exact score tie -> ascending numeric root_step then pilot_id. Failure to provide two eligible unique states -> HOLD, no alternate pool.
selection.selection_scale: Population SD of all 36 blind candidate rows, computed without rewards/visits/model scores; zero scale becomes 1.0. Only for selecting this development subset, not for NN normalization.
selection.eligibility: both recorded goal flags false, both initial collision flags false, all features finite; preserve actual acceleration fields
selection.exclusions: 384 legacy trajectories not repeated, not used to fit this candidate; their two NEW24 root identities outside pool36; no outcome-based replacements.
selection.selection_bias_boundary: Ordered-episode, quota-constrained heuristic on an already examined pool; no k-center approximation guarantee, no random population sampling.
selection.same_x_boundary: 12D key used only for experimental duplication control and split guard, NOT full state/context identity.

sampling.stream: Fresh Random(seed) per (root,forced_action,outer_seed); shared integer across actions = replicate index only, not identical rollout or iid guarantee.
sampling.scope_of_n: 1536 trajectory samples over 12 root inputs from 6 episodes/3 scenes; not 1536 independent states.
sampling.time_budget: No cloud run authorized. Wall/CPU/RAM budget must be fixed from technical cost probe before scientific START; zero claimed runtime estimate here.
sampling.why_4_plus_4: A deliberately bounded feasibility pilot with a second batch for empirical confirmation; not a statistically sufficient sample-size claim.

labels.atol_role: Inherited arithmetic-comparison guard only; not epsilon_Q, useful-effect threshold, safety margin or confidence level.
labels.return_repetitions: Keep every Y_z, terminal cause and valid flag; means/std are descriptive; no success-only conditioning.
labels.discovery_rule: i>j candidate iff every planned observation for both is valid, neither has any artificial cutoff, and min(Y_i^D)-max(Y_j^D)>atol; analogous reversed direction.
labels.confirmation_rule: Only previously fixed candidates: same range separation direction in C AND over D union C; otherwise mask=0. Confirm all16 actions, not only chosen winners.
labels.unknown_encoding: mask=0; direction=null (never train y=0 as a true tie)
labels.zero_evidence_root: valid zero mask with explicit count; never manufacture pairs or drop silently to claim full scene support
labels.graph: Store direct observed edges; check acyclicity. No transitive pseudo-label promotion and no hard-safe action elimination.

later_learning_contract.pair_weighting: Equal known-pair weight within root; input-group/scene weights explicit. No Q-gap amplification.
later_learning_contract.zero_mask_aggregation: Exclude zero-mask groups from differentiable loss only; publish their counts and full denominator. If a required training scene has no pairs, training HOLD; no reweighting to hide absence.
later_learning_contract.normalization: Only eligible training groups of each fold; exact feature names/units/order retained; zero-SD guard specified in the later trainer contract.
later_learning_contract.primary_split: Leave one full episode out, six fixed folds; all actions, repeats and labels of a root stay together; remove every training group sharing a 12D key OR state/context identity with heldout data.
later_learning_contract.source_leakage_guard: Never pretrain on 2356/57 old records, including heldout provenance, then call the new leaveout unseen. Fresh model initialization required for this pilot diagnostic.
later_learning_contract.fold_size_expected: 12 selected roots =>10 training and2 heldout per fold before any valid-label or duplicate guards.
later_learning_contract.secondary_loso: Whole-scene leaveout may be designed later; not authorized here, six folds do not prove unseen-scene generalization.
later_learning_contract.heldout_usage: Fixed model recipe; no checkpoint, threshold or seed selection on heldout results. Candidate fit/optimization protocol is a separate gate.
metrics: heldout return loss vs same-batch empirical oracle, labeled empirical not true regret
immediate-reward baseline evaluated only on same valid pairs
later_learning_contract.known_limit: 12 roots only, old development pool, acceleration support may still be zero, no claimed feature adequacy/convergence/deployment readiness.

trajectory: outer seed plus serialized RNG at checkpoints
forced vs selected action and legal action set
decision: monotonic wrapper elapsed separated from source time
required_logs.timing: Monotonic per-search + per-trajectory execution elapsed, setup/io/packing separated; saving timing must not influence policy or RNG. Do not recover old missing timings from simulation seconds.
unavailable: full-tree expansion totals unless actual counter bound
required_logs.geometry: Retain current 0.1s sampled/1m cached planning-model scope, not exact continuous/controller safety; no added threshold.

execution_gates.later_cloud_technical: 12 roots x16 one-step parity + wrapper/logging-on/off parity for actions(0,0),(3,3) at proposed techseed51900; no scientific labels from technical cells.
technical_requirements: wall resource bound before scientific sampling
execution_gates.sample_stages: Discovery and confirmation are separate authorizations/namespaces. No automatic chain execution.

stopping_and_claims.technical: Missing source/context, failed single-step parity, NaN/schema inconsistency, resource interruption ->technical HOLD, preserve artifacts; no automatic rerun.
stopping_and_claims.scientific: A hard failure or a valid64s timeout is data, not a retry reason. Finish fixed cells when resources/technical integrity allow. Overlap/unconfirmed/censored pairs remain unknown.
stopping_and_claims.no_signal: No eligible labels in a required scene -> record insufficient support, do not lower thresholds or enlarge horizon/seeds. Any next hypothesis gets a separate prospective protocol.
stopping_and_claims.end: Stop after fixed batch; freeze raw data and empirical masks before any optional learning. No automatic training, deployment or pruning.
stopping_and_claims.statistical_branch: Independent HOLD; risk/epsilon/delta not guessed and not a blocker for descriptive development work.
